description: Reproduces the three Apollonius-circle figures in candidate (ii) of conj:im-q-physical-role, flagged by witness-block-agreement as absent from all 68 witnesses declaring that block. CAL-2 is m_mu/m_e = Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 with hbar_q = 1 - 1/q; over complex q the modulus condition |1 - 1/q| = k is the Apollonius locus |q-1| = k|q|, whose centre is 1/(1-k^2), radius k/(1-k^2) and leftmost point 1/(1+k), with k^2 = Vol(4_1)/(m_mu/m_e). At 40 dps this gives 1.00991452124, 0.100064074317 and 0.909850446921 -- exactly the published 1.0099145, 0.1000641 and 0.9098504 -- and the published table closes on itself, centre minus radius equalling the leftmost point exactly. NO q0 IS NEEDED: the circle is fixed by Vol(4_1) and the mass ratio alone, because CAL-2 is the equation that defines q0, so no anchor question reaches these numbers. Both CODATA vintages (206.7682830 and 206.7682827) reproduce all three, diverging only in the 11th-12th significant digit against 8 published, which resolves one of the three 206.7682830 content sites qou-i229 left open as 'needs reading' -- as a NON-DEFECT: the block quotes CAL-2's own input rather than asserting a CODATA vintage. Verdict: category (c), correct but unwitnessed; record the producer, change nothing.
caveats: These values are COMPUTED from Vol(4_1) = 2 Cl_2(pi/3) and the mass ratio, not transcribed from the block. The distinction matters: witness-block-agreement cannot tell a computed figure from a copied one, so a witness closing a row must be able to say where its numbers came from. Here it is mpmath's clsin and CAL-2.
Says nothing about whether candidate (ii) is right or whether Im(q) has a physical role; the block states its own closure condition and this probe does not evaluate it.
Says nothing about the reality argument that empties the branches -- that is what the block's 68 declaring witnesses do, and it is untouched.
q0AnchorReason: compares two vintages of the CAL-2 muon calibration on purpose: k^2 = Vol(4_1)/(m_mu/m_e) at CODATA 2018 (206.7682830) and CODATA 2022 (206.7682827); no q0 pin is read directly, and the result is the vintage comparison
